plans.acceptanceCriteria: tags DDL carries canonical_note_id TEXT REFERENCES notes(note_id) ON DELETE SET NULL; quickMemoNotebookKindTag = "notebook-kind:quick-memo" constant with stable id appended to systemNotebookKindTags; currentVersion = 20 with the unsupportedLegacyVersion guard intact; new tests cover column presence, SET NULL on note deletion, kind-tag seed and the version guard (design E1, C3-seed).

ensureQuickMemoNotebook() mirrors bootstrapLongTermMemoryNotebook() (single transaction, singleton invariant failure on duplicate kind tag, title "Quick Memos", system kind tag deletable:false); captureQuickMemo(bodyMarkdown:title:) routes through createNote so the auto-action outbox and NoteChangeFeed apply unchanged, proven by tests; idempotency and deleted-notebook recreation covered (design C3, C4).

promoteTagCanonicalNote(tagId:noteId:) / unpromoteTagCanonicalNote(tagId:) implement the E2 validation matrix (missing tag/note, folder-class and document-kind rejection, last-promote-wins replacement, no-op unpromote) and publish change events; coOccurringTags(tagId:limit:) per E4 excluding system kind and folder tags; tagDetail(tagId:) payload extended with canonicalNote and co-occurrence; an EXPLAIN QUERY PLAN test asserts idx_note_tags_tag use (no full scan).

ServerContracts.route gains POST /note/capture implementing contract C6 exactly ({text required non-empty, title?} -> 201 {noteId, notebookId, noteNumber}; 400/401/405/503 reusing the existing helper body shapes byte-for-byte); GET /note/capture serves the SPA bootstrap through the existing /note/register rewrite pattern; route tests cover every status body in both authenticated and --allow-unauthenticated modes (design C1, C2, C5, C6).

tagDetail payload exposes canonicalNote and coOccurringTags(limit); promoteTagNote(input:{tagId,noteId}) and unpromoteTagNote(input:{tagId}) return NoteMutationPayload; operation allow-lists updated; GraphQLNoteSchemaContract.swift SDL text updated; executor tests pass (design E6).
